name: fibbers
description: A bottom-nav dashboard plugin for Home Assistant: a viewport-pinned bottom bar, modal sheets, self-computing room tiles, and dark theming. Lit + Tailwind web components, bundled to a single file.

scripts.build: bun run gen-tw && bun build src/index.js --outfile dist/fibbers.js --format=iife --target=browser --conditions=production --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --banner="/*! Fibbers v0.7.5 — GENERATED from src/ by 'bun run build'. Do not hand-edit. */"
scripts.watch: bun build src/index.js --outfile dist/fibbers.js --format=iife --target=browser --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' --banner="/*! Fibbers v0.7.5 — GENERATED from src/ by 'bun run build'. Do not hand-edit. */" --watch
scripts.check: prettier --check "src/**/*.js" "docs/*.html" && bun run lint && bun run build && bun scripts/check-icons.mjs && bun scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('dist/fibbers.js','utf8'))"
